name: Exuvia
description: Character-first avatar layer for OpenClaw. Adds a play_animation tool driven by per-avatar animation catalogues.

additionalProperties.// note: Schema is intentionally permissive — the desktop app owns the avatar shape and evolves it independently. Claw stores whatever the app puts here.

avatarPath.description: Path to the avatar model file (.fbx, .glb, or .gltf). The desktop app picks the loader by extension.

fbxPath.description: Legacy alias for avatarPath. Both are accepted; avatarPath wins when both are set.

fbxScale.description: Model scale. Default depends on format (0.01 for fbx, 1.0 for glb).

voiceOnChannels.description: If true, attach a TTS voice note on every outbound message delivered to chat channels (Telegram/WhatsApp/iMessage/Discord). Default false. Voice still plays in the desktop app regardless.

postProcessing.description: Optional per-avatar post-processing config consumed by the desktop app. Schema is owned by exuvia-app, not validated here so the app can evolve effects independently.

gifPath.description: Optional path to a pre-rendered gif/webp/mp4 of this clip. Attached as MEDIA on chat-channel deliveries so users on Telegram/Discord/etc. see the animation.
